sections.title: Player win rates
sections.tldr: BabyGolem leads at 69.2%, ragnarneves trails at 30.8%, on 13 games. One standard error is about 14 points.

sections.title: Duo win rates
sections.tldr: Best pairing: GRCX + BabyGolem at 80.0% (4-1). Worst: RikiPlancha12 + ragnarneves at 20.0% (1-4). Every duo has few games, so none of this is settled.

sections.title: Champion win rates
sections.tldr: 43 distinct champions in 52 player-games. Best with >= 2 games: Dr. Mundo 100.0% (2-0), Lillia 100.0% (2-0), Mordekaiser 100.0% (2-0).

sections.title: Tilt tracker
sections.tldr: After a loss: 40.9% (22 games). After a win: 59.1% (22 games). Losses are followed by more losses, but within sampling noise.

sections.title: Session fatigue
sections.tldr: 2 sessions, longest 10 games. Late-session samples are small and biased. Biggest drop from games 1-3 to 4+: GRCX (66.7% to 42.9%).

sections.title: Time of day
sections.tldr: 8 of 13 games began between 00:00 and 05:59.

sections.title: Game length buckets
sections.tldr: Short: 1 games, mid: 12, long: 0. Best in short games: GRCX (100.0%).

sections.title: Stomp vs throw
sections.tldr: Average game 14:54; shortest 11:22 (won by GRCX + BabyGolem), longest 18:47 (won by BabyGolem + RikiPlancha12). Widest loss-vs-win length gap: GRCX (+116 s).

sections.title: Multikills
sections.tldr: GRCX leads with 12 multikills. Group: 25 doubles, 0 triples, 0 quadras, 0 pentas.

sections.title: First blood
sections.tldr: Teams with first blood won 69.2% (9-4); without it 30.8% (4-9). Most first-blood kills: GRCX (6).

sections.title: Combat profile
sections.tldr: Highest kill pace: GRCX (0.48/min). Highest death pace: BabyGolem (0.41/min), lowest: ragnarneves (0.40/min). Lowest damage per kill (kill-steal index): BabyGolem (3,746).

sections.title: Team share
sections.tldr: GRCX takes the largest damage share (56.3%); RikiPlancha12 is the biggest punching bag (32,284 damage taken per game).

sections.title: Champion pool
sections.tldr: Widest pool: RikiPlancha12 (13 champions in 13 games). Narrowest: GRCX (favourite Kai'Sa x3).

sections.title: Liability index
sections.tldr: Highest deaths per minute: Kai'Sa (0.47), then Samira (0.42), Vayne (0.42). Min 2 games.

sections.title: Records

sections.title: Worst defeats
sections.tldr: Most deaths in a loss: BabyGolem on Shen, 11 deaths (61.1% of the team's deaths).

sections.title: Clean execution

sections.title: Time dead
sections.tldr: BabyGolem spends the most estimated time dead (20.3% of playtime). Dead time is estimated; alive time is exact.

sections.title: Augments
sections.tldr: 115 distinct augments picked. Best with >= 3 games: Final Form 100.0% (3-0), Escape Plan 75.0% (3-1), Ocean Soul 75.0% (3-1). Worst: Transmute: Prismatic 0.0% (0-4), Bread and Cheese 0.0% (0-3), Blunt Force 33.3% (1-2).
